title: 1.6 The Quantum Mechanical Model of the Atom
description: Heisenberg uncertainty principle, quantum numbers, and shapes of atomic orbitals

questions.question: The quantum mechanical description of the atom depends on two central concepts:
options: the wave behavior of matter and the uncertainty principle
questions.correctAnswer: the wave behavior of matter and the uncertainty principle

options: can be measured separately with equal precision

questions.question: The Heisenberg uncertainty principle has very significant consequences when it is applied to:
options: everyday objects in the macroscopic world

questions.question: Erwin Schrodinger suggested that an electron exhibiting wavelike properties can be described by a mathematical equation called a wave function, represented by:
In quantum mechanics, the square of the wave function ($\psi^2$) gives:
options: the probability of finding an electron in a certain region of space
the exact location of the electron
questions.correctAnswer: the probability of finding an electron in a certain region of space
